texts.label: Mary Queen of Scots to Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r
texts.summary: Written after Moray's murder at Linlithgow (23 Jan 1570): Mary tells Norfolk she will undertake nothing unless it is safe for them both, urges him to write and to act through his sister Scrope or others, says Elizabeth gives her the blame ('veyt') for Moray's death, reports rumours of Morton and Lord Talbot, and begs him not to risk writing in his own hand. Signs transcribed line by line on 23 Oct 2026 (texts/f74r_signs.tsv); partial running text in texts/f74r_reading.md.
texts.note: Re-read sign by sign 23 Oct 2026 (batch b31; texts/f74r_signs.tsv, f74r_corrections.tsv, partial reading f74r_reading.md, f74r_en.md): four supplied words of the old reading withdrawn as not carried; 13 unkeyed signs, each single or in one small family, none adoptable. Scores 0.229 plain, 0.829 explicit holes only, 0.714 with the unkeyed signs counted as holes; look-alike letters 3/1493. Kept decoded, not read: the opening sentence, the 'For I have experiance' sentence, the cardinal clause, ll. 10-11 and l. 15 do not build, and legible runs in ll. 11, 15, 17, 20 are not yet resolved; ff. 66, 69, 75 not yet searched for the unkeyed signs.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: f. 74r, the only document, is decoded, not read, so no tokens are in a document that reads. The field was "unknown" before.
